title: Chapter 581
text:
The location of the exchange was an uninhabited planet with a serial number. Both parties would not meet, and Han Xiao would leave after putting down Befuli. The galactic pirates would then come to pick up Befuli and release the kidnapped mercenaries before informing Han Xiao to pick them up and exchange the hostages.

Sykes did this for safety reasons. Although he was a galactic pirate and did not have much credibility, often going back on his words, he was very sincere this time. He only wanted to get Befuli back and did not want to completely anger Black Star.

As long as he obtained Befuli, he would immediately withdraw the subordinates he sent to the Garton Star System and follow the agreement to not provoke the Black Star Corps again.

However, Han Xiao did not think this way. After provoking him, they wanted him to act as if nothing had happened.

Not far away from the serial number planet, the Blacklight Stealth floated quietly in space.

Through the porthole, Han Xiao silently looked at this brown planet.

This time, he did not call anyone else and was acting alone. Using the Blacklight Stealth, which was known for its speed, was not just for the exchange of hostages.

He placed an [Observer's Mark] on Befuli, which was equivalent to a human body surveillance device. Han Xiao's plan was to use the talent of [Chaos Observer] to follow these galactic pirates, find Sykes' nest, and then have sex with all of them.

He had never squeezed the juice out of a Calamity Grade Super before.

The exchange of hostages was to temporarily stabilize Sykes and prevent him from acting recklessly. Although the players were not afraid of threats, Han Xiao did not want anyone to destroy the first batch of mercenaries of the Black Star Corps.

"It's about time …"

Han Xiao piloted the spaceship into the atmosphere and flew toward the designated location.

As he got closer and closer to the surface, he suddenly froze. He saw a galactic pirate's spaceship parked beside the designated location.

"Didn't we agree not to meet? Why are they waiting for me here? Could it be that they want to exchange the hostages face to face? "

Doubts flashed through his mind. Han Xiao parked the spaceship further away and went to the warehouse. He carried the dying Befuli, opened the hatch, and walked out of the spaceship.

Ta ta …

His feet stepped on the brown surface of the ground, raising a cloud of dust. Along the uneven ground, the galactic pirate's spaceship was parked a few thousand meters away. It was like a small dot in his field of vision. A few galactic pirates seemed to be guarding the spaceship and waving at him.

Han Xiao frowned.

"It feels strange. Risda, don't turn off the engine. If anything happens, take off immediately."

"Alright." Risda took over the control of the spaceship.

Han Xiao led Befuli and walked slowly for a while. When they got close to the pirate ship, he looked at the few pirates beside the ship and said in a deep voice, "Let's go.

"I've brought him here. Where are my mercenaries?"

Hardly had he finished his sentence when Han Xiao's eyes suddenly froze. He discovered that the space pirates were wearing weird and frightened expressions.

Before he could do anything, a sudden change occurred!

Bang!

A hole was left on the cabin door of the space pirate's starship. A black shadow rushed to Han Xiao like a meteorite and punched Han Xiao's abdomen heavily with his fist that was covered in thick iron.

A terrifying power erupted from his fist.

Boom!

A shockwave-like shockwave spread out, and Han Xiao was sent flying in a straight line like a cannonball. He flew more than a thousand meters away and crashed into a bare mountain, burying himself in the rubble. Dust filled the air.

The person who sent Han Xiao flying with a punch was standing where Han Xiao originally was. He was wearing heavy metal armor and had the bloodline of the Demon Race. He had two horns on his head, one of which was only half left. It was one of the eight Vanguard Officials of Bloodshed Land, 'Broken Horn' Malekith!

The wind created by this attack sent Befuli and a few other galactic pirates flying and crashing into the ground not far away.

A few weaker galactic pirates broke a few bones and screamed in pain. They hurriedly hid far away from this battlefield.

Hualala!

Han Xiao jumped out of the rubble and rubbed his stomach. The pain quickly subsided.

"This damage … Grade A Super? Sykes came personally to kill me? " Looking at the combat information, Han Xiao was a little surprised. "It's not Sykes, but Malekith … Who is this guy? He doesn't look like Sykes' subordinate … This name sounds a little familiar. "

Strange, I've never met this person before. Why is he targeting me? Could he be an assassin hired by someone? No, one person is probably not enough to kill me …

Han Xiao looked at Malekith and frowned. All kinds of guesses flashed through his mind.

The two of them looked at each other and did not speak.

"I can feel that the attack just now did not cause you any damage. 'Indestructible Body' Black Star, you live up to your name."

Malekith spoke first. His tone was indifferent, and his words were powerful.

Indestructible Body? Is this my new nickname?

Han Xiaoxin narrowed his eyes and said, "Who are you? Why did you attack me? "

"You'll know after the fight."

Malekith did not say anything else, and a thick purplish-black Pugilist flame ignited around his body. He took large strides forward and charged toward Han Xiao like a meteor. The heavy armor on his body started to move, and its structure became more complex. It seemed to have entered combat mode.

Han Xiao cursed in his mind. With a flash of Mechanical Force, the black and gold Berserk Ape mechanical suit attached to his body and caught Malekith's fist. A shockwave instantly spread out.

Han Xiao's weight and strength were no match for Malekith's, and he was instantly pushed back. His legs dug deep trenches in the ground.

Hum!

At this time, the figure of a Godora suddenly appeared behind Han Xiao.

He had used Nagojin's Character Summon Card.

Muscles are the truth!

Han Xiao could clearly feel the muscles in his body swelling up. His entire body was filled with endless strength, and his Strength attribute suddenly skyrocketed!

The momentum of the Berserk Ape mechanical suit stopped for a moment, and Han Xiao planted his feet into the ground. The torque of the Berserk Ape mechanical suit suddenly increased, and Han Xiao's waist and arms were twisted into an arc that he was about to throw. He grabbed onto Malekith's fist with both hands and threw Malekith over his shoulder!

The moment Malekith left his hand, he broke through the sound barrier and was thrown out in a straight line. His speed was extremely fast, and in the blink of an eye, he became a small dot in his field of vision. He crashed into the bottom of the undulating mountain range in the distance, and the ground trembled slightly.

The ability of the Berserk Ape mechanical suit — Berserk Throw!

Han Xiao glanced at the enemy's information. Most of them were question marks, and his heart skipped a beat.

This meant that Malekith's overall level was much higher than his.

Han Xiao was also confused as to why Malekith would be at the handover location and why he would attack him. He had not expected such a sudden accident. Since Malekith did not explain, he could only fight first.

Han Xiao quickly cleared his mind and entered a focused state. He threw out compressed orbs one after another. The twelve repaired Oathkeepers circled around him, and the Hovering Shield Shuttle floated behind him, flickering with golden energy.

As this was an emergency, Han Xiao did not have enough time to completely repair the Mech Legion, nor did he have the time to upgrade the machines used in the current battle mode. He was still using the same equipment as before, and the only exception was the Berserk Ape.

Just this mechanical suit alone should be enough to deal with this battle.

His opponent was a Calamity Grade Pugilist, and he did not seem to have any killing intent. As such, he could not be bothered to take out more machines.

Malekith's skin was thick, and he wore a set of specially made heavy armor. His defense was extremely high, and he had the bloodline of the Demon Race, so his recovery speed was very high.

In a breath's time, his light injuries were automatically healed.

Malekith did not care about the dust on his body and charged forward once again!

…
